caption:
Name your savings. 🏷️

An account called "Savings" gets raided. One called "Roof Fund" or "Car Repairs" gets respected.

Most banks let you rename accounts or add sub-accounts for free.

What would you name yours?
first_comment: What's your savings account called? Funniest name wins. 👇
